Is Google Kubernetes Engine end of life?

Some Google Kubernetes Engine releases are end of life. GKE 1.31 is past end of extended support as of 2026-10-22. This page lists 5 reviewed lifecycle rules for pkg:generic/google-kubernetes-engine, with the status, date, and source for each.

Check a version:

offing check pkg:generic/google-kubernetes-engine

All product answers

Rule Status Date Affected versions Sources
GKE 1.31 is past end of extended support End of life 2026-10-22 vers:semver/>=1.31.0|<1.32.0 GKE versioning and support, GKE release schedule
GKE 1.30 is past end of extended support End of life 2026-07-30 vers:semver/>=1.30.0|<1.31.0 GKE versioning and support, GKE release schedule
GKE 1.29 and earlier are no longer supported End of life The source gives no day vers:semver/<1.30.0 GKE versioning and support, GKE release schedule
GKE 1.33 is past end of standard support End of support 2026-08-12 vers:semver/>=1.33.0|<1.34.0 GKE versioning and support, GKE release schedule
GKE 1.32 is past end of standard support End of support 2026-04-27 vers:semver/>=1.32.0|<1.33.0 GKE versioning and support, GKE release schedule
